recommendation: Keep the fix. It preserves the accepted FHIR-7737 clarification without restoring obsolete repeated-dosageInstruction wording or the original typo, and it aligns MedicationRequest with the current DosageDetails model and the prior FHIR-8502 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-7737 was a Published Pharmacy change request resolved Persuasive. It asked to add to the MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction comment another example of changing dose/rate instructions: institutional IV titration of a medication dose to maintain a specified hemodynamic value or range.
initial_application: Git commit 6fa885f693 explicitly applied #7737 by adding the requested titration sentence to medication order dosageInstruction spreadsheet source. The exact historical wording no longer appears in current source because MedicationPrescription/MedicationOrder became MedicationRequest and later dosage refactors replaced repeated Dosage instructions with a single DosageDetails structure.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationRequest in active build scope and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Current MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction is 0..1 DosageDetails and lacked a local comment carrying the FHIR-7737 clarification, while nearby MedicationRequest.effectiveTiming and example descriptors still referred to multiple dosageInstruction lines. The combined branch already contains the related FHIR-8502 source fix aligning rate-change guidance in the reusable Dosage datatype and MedicationDispense with current DosageDetails semantics; dosage narrative likewise says DosageDetails steps/components represent complex dosage regimes and renderedInstruction carries the full dosage intent.
reconciliation: Added a MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction comment that expresses the FHIR-7737 titration clarification in R6 terms: dose/rate changes, including IV titration to maintain a specified hemodynamic value or range, use DosageDetails and must communicate the full intent in renderedInstruction. Updated MedicationRequest.effectiveTiming and the MedicationRequest example list/header text to refer to multiple DosageDetails steps rather than impossible multiple dosageInstruction lines.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml: added a DosageDetails/renderedInstruction dosageInstruction comment including the accepted IV titration/hemodynamic-range example, and updated effectiveTiming wording from multiple dosageInstruction lines to multiple steps.
source/medicationrequest/list-MedicationRequest-examples.xml: updated active example descriptions for tapering/chemotherapy examples to say multiple DosageDetails steps.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-examples-header.xml: updated rendered example-list header text for the same MedicationRequest examples to say multiple DosageDetails steps.

related_jiras.note: Later Pharmacy rate-change guidance adjusted MedicationOrder/MedicationAdministration/MedicationDispense comments; the combined branch already contains a source fix aligning that family with DosageDetails.
The DosageInstruction-to-Dosage refactor explains why older dosageInstruction wording moved away from the original MedicationPrescription comment location.
Current R6 dosage work introduced DosageDetails for complex dosage regimes, shaping how FHIR-7737 needed to be expressed now.
Later DosageDetails cleanup confirms the current steps/components model used by this reconciliation.
